title: Final Answers
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that net work is done on the system and that the work on the monatomic gas is greater than that on the diatomic gas.

title: PV Diagram for Monatomic
description: Important Criteria: The student should accurately sketch the isothermal and adiabatic processes for the monatomic gas on the pV diagram.

title: PV Diagram for Diatomic
description: Important Criteria: The student should accurately sketch the isothermal and adiabatic processes for the diatomic gas on the pV diagram.

title: Pressure Calculations
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the pressures at points B and C for both gases.

title: Work Done Explanation
description: Optional Criteria: The student should provide a clear explanation of why net work is done on the system based on the pV diagrams.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect pressure calculations or mislabeling the processes on the diagrams.
